name: smart-project-time-tracker
description: Smart Project Management and Employee Time Tracking System

scripts.deploy:preview: npm run deploy:copy-lib && npx wrangler pages dev client/dist --port 8788

scripts.deploy:copy-lib: rm -rf functions/_lib && mkdir -p functions/_lib && cp -R server/src/. functions/_lib/
